name: Unified routing (Dynamics 365)
short_description: Unified routing in Dynamics 365 Customer Service and Contact Center sends incoming cases and conversations to the most suitable queue or service representative based on rules, skills, presence and capacity, using push or pick assignment.

evidence.quote: Behind the scenes, unified rooting works like the reception desk for the entire service team
place the request in the right waiting line. That process is called routing.
this knowledge nugget puts Dynamics 365 unified rooting into plain English
So unified routing tackles the larger problem.
